name: zmath_mat_load_rotation_from_3x3
description: zMath::MatLoadRotationFrom3x3 copies the source matrix 3x3 rotation basis into the current matrix while preserving current translation.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs under local manifest zmath_mat_load_rotation_from_3x3 verifies this helper with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x473280 shows a no-callee helper that copies the first nine float fields from the source matrix into the current matrix slot and clears the current-matrix identity flag.
The native smoke checks that the rotation basis is copied, the destination translation is preserved, and subsequent direction transforms use the loaded basis.
